findings: All four resolve exact requested raw cache activity, read source activity metadata and run fresh activity_inspect.py followed by analysis_packet.py. Relevant streams and long-ride Garmin/Xert summaries are inspected.
No commands supplied write externally or modify source/context files. Derived analysis outputs are permitted. No followup tool commands.
Some direct CSV inspections fail before corrected retries; verified final claims are supported.
No unsupported historical thresholds, numeric RPE, invented intake, fixed recovery duration, or diagnosis of glycogen depletion/respiratory limitation/heat limitation.
All responses are ordinary Norwegian coaching prose, not evaluation JSON. Initial responses could be shorter but provide interpretation and useful uncertainty, rather than only metrics.
